Name: Zebadiah, Son of Ishmael
Role: Ruler of the House of Judah
Summary: Zebadiah, son of Ishmael and ruler of the house of Judah, was set by Jehoshaphat over all the king's matters in the Jerusalem court.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat appointed Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Amariah, Chief Priest; Ishmael, Father of Zebadiah
LifeLesson: Civil and sacred duties both deserve faithful, courageous service.
